messages.subject: Draft letter before action - Penrose v Caldervale
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Draft letter before action attached for your review. It sets out the conditional acceptance regime, the three dependency failures (SKU data, host latency, promotional surge), the withheld £1,437,500, and accepts the repudiation. I've flagged the loss at c.£2.0m pending the schedule of loss.

Grateful for your mark-up.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0500
